text:
We just got a free, open-source Codex-style agent for VS Code. 🤙

It's called OpenCodex, and it looks pretty promising to test out. Based on the repo, it can inspect your codebase, plan multi-step tasks, edit files, execute terminal commands, leverage MCP tools, and more.

Best part? You can get started right away using the default provider without needing an API key. :)

GitHub repo 🔗: github.com/matonhp5108/Opencodex
